d: We are seeking a skilled and technically proficient Network Administrator / Senior Network Engineer / Network Engineer to design, implement, manage, and maintain the organization's network infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring network availability, performance, security, and reliability while supporting business operations, troubleshooting technical issues, and implementing network improvements. This role requires strong technical expertise, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage complex network environments.
Design, configure, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure.
Manage LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN, routers, switches, firewalls, and network security systems.
Monitor network performance, availability, bandwidth utilization, and system reliability.
Troubleshoot network connectivity issues, hardware failures, and performance problems.
Perform network maintenance, upgrades, configuration changes, and infrastructure optimization.
Implement network security policies, access controls, and security monitoring procedures.
Manage network infrastructure, IP addressing, VLANs, routing, switching, and DNS services.
Conduct network assessments, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
Maintain network documentation, configuration records, technical diagrams, and operational procedures.
Support server connectivity, cloud networking, data centers, and IT infrastructure integration.
Coordinate with IT teams, vendors, service providers, and external technical partners.
Implement backup, disaster recovery, and network redundancy solutions.
Lead network projects, technical improvements, and infrastructure deployment initiatives.
Provide technical support, guidance, and mentoring to junior IT personnel where required.
Proven experience in network administration, network engineering, or IT infrastructure management.
Strong knowledge of networking protocols, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, and switching.
Hands-on experience with routers, switches, firewalls, wireless networks, and VPN technologies.
Familiarity with network monitoring, troubleshooting, and security management tools.
Understanding of network security, access control, cybersecurity principles, and infrastructure protection.
Experience with enterprise networking equipment and technologies such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, or equivalent platforms.
Knowledge of cloud networking, virtualization, and data center infrastructure is an advantage.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage network projects, technical documentation, and operational priorities.
Excellent communication, teamwork, and technical reporting skills.
Professional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or equivalent are advantageous.
Good command of English; additional languages are an advantage.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international business environment.

d: 🌟 We're Hiring: Strategic Buyer / Strategic Sourcing Specialist / Sourcing Executive

We are a business-focused organization committed to strengthening procurement performance, building reliable supplier networks, and supporting sustainable commercial growth. Through strategic sourcing, supplier collaboration, and effective cost management, we aim to create value and improve supply chain efficiency across our business operations.

We are seeking an experienced procurement and sourcing professional to support strategic purchasing activities, supplier relationship management, and sourcing initiatives. This role will contribute to identifying qualified suppliers, evaluating commercial opportunities, and securing competitive purchasing arrangements that meet business requirements.

Working remotely with flexible part-time hours, you will collaborate with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to improve sourcing processes, manage procurement priorities, and support long-term business objectives.
Develop and implement sourcing strategies aligned with business and procurement objectives.
Identify, evaluate, and select suitable suppliers based on quality, cost, reliability, and service.
Conduct supplier negotiations to achieve competitive pricing and favorable commercial terms.
Manage supplier relationships and support long-term strategic partnerships.
Review purchasing requirements and identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.
Monitor supplier performance, market conditions, and procurement trends.
Coordinate with finance, operations, and relevant departments to support purchasing activities.
Evaluate quotations, proposals, and supplier agreements to ensure commercial suitability.
Support procurement planning, sourcing documentation, and purchasing reports.
Identify potential supply risks and recommend practical measures to maintain procurement continuity.
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in strategic sourcing, purchasing, or procurement preferred.
Strong understanding of sourcing strategies, supplier evaluation, and purchasing processes.
Knowledge of commercial negotiations, cost analysis, and supplier relationship management.
Familiarity with procurement documentation, contract terms, and purchasing procedures.
Ability to assess supplier proposals and identify cost-effective sourcing opportunities.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication and negotiation abilities when working with suppliers and stakeholders.
Proficiency in procurement reporting and relevant business systems.
Ability to manage priorities independently and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.
Flexible part-time working hours with a fully remote arrangement.
Competitive compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
Opportunities to contribute to strategic procurement and sourcing initiatives.
Exposure to supplier networks and commercial projects across different markets.
Professional development in strategic sourcing, procurement, and supplier management.
A collaborative environment that values commercial awareness, accountability, and continuous improvement.
